description: The unsigned PayAccountFactory.fundWithETH(account, minUsdg) transaction with the ETH as value: swapped to USDG on the way in and sent to the account, at least minUsdg or it reverts (default: Chainlink's ETH price less 1%; the factory itself refuses below Chainlink less 2%, and while that price is older than 48 hours). Any wallet can fund any pay account. Sending USDG straight to the account works too.

from.description: Optional: the wallet that sends it.

minUsdg.description: Optional: the least USDG the swap may give.

name: pay_account_fund_eth_transaction
title: Mercatura Pay: fund a pay account with ETH
